title: MULTI-CLARID (Multimodal Category Learning and Resting-state Imaging Data)
description: MULTI-CLARID is a combined fMRI/EEG dataset acquired during an auditory category learning task and resting state. It includes 63-channel EEG with ECG, EOG, facial EMG and skin conductance, plus respiration and finger-pulse recordings, and T1-weighted and UTE anatomical MR scans. Five participants' datasets containing the multi-dimensional category learning experiment are currently shared.
methods_description: Data were acquired on a 3T Philips Achieva dStream scanner with a 32-channel head coil. EEG was recorded at 5 kHz with BrainAmp MRplus and ExG MR amplifiers, along with physiological signals and button presses. Participants learned by trial and error, with auditory feedback, to categorize frequency-modulated sounds in 180 trials (~27 min), followed by a 10 min eyes-closed resting-state fMRI. MR-artifact correction and preprocessing were performed in BrainVision Analyzer 2.3.
